test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 17 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: SBM Bank India entered into a bancassurance partnership with which among the following companies in May 2025?

options.text: Axis Max Life Insurance Co. Ltd.

solution:
The correct answer is __**ICICI Prudential Life Insurance**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **SBM Bank India** entered into a strategic **bancassurance** partnership with **ICICI Prudential Life Insurance** to provide its customers with a comprehensive range of **life insurance** products.
 
• Through this partnership, **SBM Bank India** aims to offer its **private banking** and **retail** customers a diverse portfolio of insurance solutions, including **wealth management**, **retirement**, and **protection** plans.
 
• This collaboration leverages **SBM Bank's** extensive distribution network and **ICICI Prudential's** digital-first approach to provide seamless **financial services**.
 
• The primary objective of this tie-up is to enhance **financial security** and provide **long-term savings** options to the bank's growing client base across **India**.
 
• The agreement signifies a major step for **SBM Bank India** in becoming a one-stop destination for all **financial and insurance** needs of its customers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Bancassurance**:
 
 
• It is an arrangement between a **bank** and an **insurance company** that allows the insurance company to sell its products to the bank's client base.
 
• This partnership benefits the bank through **commission-based income** and provides the insurance company with a wide **distribution channel**.
 
 
 
• **SBM Bank India**:
 
 
• It is the first bank in India to receive a **Universal Banking License** from the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** to operate as a **Wholly Owned Subsidiary (WOS)** of a foreign bank.
 
• The bank is headquartered in **Mumbai** and is a subsidiary of **SBM Holdings**, which is based in **Mauritius**.
 
• The bank focuses on **corporate banking**, **retail banking**, and **wealth management** with a strong emphasis on **technology-driven** solutions.
 
 
 
• **ICICI Prudential Life Insurance**:
 
 
• It is a joint venture between **ICICI Bank Limited** and **Prudential Corporation Holdings Limited**.
 
• The company began operations in **December 2000** and was the first **private sector** life insurance company to be listed on the **National Stock Exchange (NSE)** and **Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE)**.
 
• It offers a wide range of products including **Term Insurance**, **Health Insurance**, and **Unit Linked Insurance Plans (ULIPs)**.
 
 
 
• **Regulatory Framework**:
 
 
• The **Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)** governs the guidelines for **bancassurance** to ensure that consumer interests are protected and **mis-selling** is prevented.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Financial Inclusion**: Such partnerships are vital for increasing **insurance penetration** in **India**, especially among the middle-class and affluent segments served by private banks.
 
• **Digital Integration**: Both entities emphasize **digital ecosystems**, allowing customers to purchase and manage policies via **mobile banking** and **internet banking** platforms.
 
• **SBM Bank's Presence**: As of **2024-2025**, the bank has been expanding its footprint in **metropolitan cities** and through **Neo-banking** partnerships to reach a wider demographic.
</ul
